original:
श्रवण कीर्तन स्मरण। पादसेवन अर्चन।
वंदन दास्य सख्य आत्मनिवेदन। नवविधा भक्ती॥
sanskrit:
श्रवण कीर्तन स्मरण। पादसेवन अर्चन।
वंदन दास्य सख्य आत्मनिवेदन। नवविधा भक्ती॥
transliteration:
śravaṇa kīrtana smaraṇa | pādasevana arcana |
vandana dāsya sakhya ātmanivedana | navavidhā bhaktī ||
translation: Listening to divine truth, singing praise, remembering the Lord, service of the lotus feet, sacred offering, obeisance, surrendered servitude, divine friendship, and complete self-offering—these are the nine limbs of Bhakti.
meaning: Dashaka 4: Navadha Bhakti (The Ninefold Path of Devotion)

layers.author: samarth-ramdas
layers.content: श्रवण, कीर्तन, स्मरण, पादसेवन, अर्चन, वंदन, दास्य, सख्य आणि आत्मनिवेदन ही नवविधा भक्तीची लक्षणे आहेत.

layers.author: warkari-scholars
layers.content: Ramdas synthesizes the Bhagavata Purana's ninefold devotional path with practical discipline, culminating in Atmanivedana (total dissolution of the false ego).

layers.author: gita-press
layers.content: श्रवण, कीर्तन, स्मरण, पादसेवन, अर्चन, वंदन, दास्य, सख्य और आत्मनिवेदन—यह नवधा भक्ति का मार्ग है।
